meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Codex 设为主智能体,接替 Claude 做规划、调用工具并恢复历史会话。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望终端 AI 的规划与工具调度由 Codex 接管。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Codex to lead planning and tool calls in your terminal instead of Claude.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 里每个 group 的 agent 后端可以换成 Codex(OpenAI 的 codex app-server),由它负责规划、工具编排和 MCP 工具调用;会话历史存在服务端,用 thread id 续接,凭据只放在 OneCLI vault。
howto.when: 当你在主机上按 group 执行 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 并重启时,该 group 的 agent 后端由 Claude 换成 Codex;安装后新建 group 默认仍是 claude。

say.text: 帮我把这个 group 的 provider 切成 codex
say.note: 会更新 group 配置并需要重启该 group

say.text: 运行 provider-auth codex,完成 Codex 认证
say.note: 走 vault 认证:ChatGPT 订阅或 API key

say.text: 把新 group 的默认 provider 设为 codex
say.note: 只影响之后创建的 group,需重启 host 生效

howto.what_en: After install, each group's agent backend in NanoClaw can be switched to Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server), which does planning, tool orchestration and MCP tool calls. History lives server-side and resumes by thread id; credentials sit only in the OneCLI vault.
howto.when_en: When you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group on the host and restart it, that group's backend switches from Claude to Codex. Newly created groups still default to claude after install.

say_en.text: Switch this group's provider to codex
say_en.note: Updates group config; restart the group after

say_en.text: Run provider-auth codex to authenticate Codex
say_en.note: Vault auth: ChatGPT subscription or API key

say_en.text: Set the default provider for new groups to codex
say_en.note: Only affects later groups; restart host
